written: 2026-11-25, before any live run of the fall check
purpose: Code-side decision for person_fell candidates from a neutral dense posture probe. Only path to 'supported' for person_fell; anything else gives 'insufficient' (alert to review, never dismissed).
note_on_ground: kneeling never counts as on the ground (people setting down or picking up a bag). It may appear between upright and ground; persistent kneeling only ever gives 'insufficient'.

probe_sampling.anchor: t_after: the candidate's 'after' frame (first frame claimed on the ground)
probe_sampling.frame_choice: first decoded frame at or after each requested time

displacement_unit: fraction of the image width; vertical offsets are converted with the frame's height/width ratio
glitch_rule: inside a ground run, at most one isolated frame labelled bending, kneeling or not_visible is tolerated if a ground frame follows; a 'standing' frame always ends the run

near_candidate.distance_note: between the person's position at the probe frame nearest t_after and the candidate's position; skipped only when the candidate carries no position
